definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of preparing and serving matcha tea.

examples.japanese: {茶道|ちゃどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
{茶道|ちゃどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
{茶道|ちゃどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Tea ceremony has many rules of etiquette.

notes:
{茶道|ちゃどう} is the traditional Japanese art of preparing and serving ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ (powdered green tea). More than just tea-making, it embodies principles of harmony (⟦{和|わ}→和：13041_wa⟧), respect (⟦{敬|けい}→敬：noentry⟧), purity (⟦{清|せい}→清：noentry⟧), and tranquility (⟦{寂|じゃく}→寂：noentry⟧).

ALTERNATIVE READING:
{茶道|さどう} is an equally common reading. ⟦{裏千家|うらせんけ}→裏千家：noentry⟧ uses さどう, while ⟦{表千家|おもてせんけ}→表千家：noentry⟧ uses ちゃどう.

KEY VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧: matcha (powdered green tea)
- ⟦{茶室|ちゃしつ}→茶室：14081_chashitsu⟧: tea room
- ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧: tea bowl
- ⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧: etiquette, proper form
- ⟦お{点前|てまえ}→お点前：18178_otemae⟧: the procedure of making tea
- ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧: alcove (where a scroll and flowers are displayed)

MAJOR SCHOOLS:
- ⟦{表千家|おもてせんけ}→表千家：noentry⟧: Omotesenke
- ⟦{裏千家|うらせんけ}→裏千家：noentry⟧: Urasenke (largest school)
- ⟦{武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ}→武者小路千家：noentry⟧: Mushanokōjisenke

{茶道|ちゃどう} is widely taught in schools and cultural centers and is considered one of the essential Japanese cultural arts.
